elements.requirement: The Company Directors Disqualification Act 1986 applies to incorporated friendly societies in the same manner as it applies to companies.
elements.quote: This Act applies to incorporated friendly societies as it applies to companies.

elements.requirement: References in the Company Directors Disqualification Act 1986 to a company include references to an incorporated friendly society within the meaning of the Friendly Societies Act 1992.
elements.quote: References in this Act to a company, or to a director or an officer of a company include, respectively, references to an incorporated friendly society within the meaning of the Friendly Societies Act 1992

elements.requirement: References in the Company Directors Disqualification Act 1986 to a director or an officer of a company include references to a member of the committee of management or officer, within the meaning of the Friendly Societies Act 1992, of an incorporated friendly society.
elements.quote: to a member of the committee of management or officer, within the meaning of that Act, of an incorporated friendly society.

elements.requirement: In relation to an incorporated friendly society, every reference in the Company Directors Disqualification Act 1986 to a shadow director must be omitted.
elements.quote: In relation to an incorporated friendly society every reference to a shadow director shall be omitted.

elements.requirement: In relation to an incorporated friendly society, the Company Directors Disqualification Act 1986 applies as if sections 6(1)(a)(ii), 6(3)(d), 7(2)(b), 8ZA to 8ZE, and 11A were omitted.
elements.quote: sections 6(1)(a)(ii) and (3)(d), 7(2)(b) , 8ZA to 8ZE and 11A were omitted

elements.requirement: In relation to an incorporated friendly society, the Company Directors Disqualification Act 1986 applies as if references in sections 7(4)(a) and 15A(3)(b) to a company that has been dissolved without becoming insolvent were omitted.
elements.quote: references in sections 7(4)(a) and 15A(3)(b) to a company which has been dissolved without becoming insolvent were omitted.
